title: One ordinary transition from a register configuration
statement: Let $P$ be a register program with oracle, let $r$ be a register index, and let $c$ be a configuration. Replace register $r$'s tape by a tape with content $f:\mathbb Z\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$ and place its head at $p\in\mathbb Z$, setting the state to $s$. If $P$ has no oracle call at $s$, then one step of its run from this configuration equals applying the machine transition prescribed by $P$ for state $s$, the scanned input symbol, and the scanned work-tape symbols.
hypotheses_covered: The program $P$ and oracle are given.
The register index $r$, configuration $c$, tape content $f$, and head position $p$ are given.
There is no oracle call at state $s$.
